summary:
Renamed the LiveStatus MTGO flag from mtgo_read_at_startup to mtgo_watching (default False, new description that each MTGO game is stored once it ends) and rewrote the class docstring so watching and mtgo_watching are both asked of the watcher object directly (is_alive(), and its mtgo_dir). /api/live now passes mtgo_watching. Regenerated web/src/types/api.ts via pnpm gen:types (not hand-edited). LiveStatus.tsx's MTGO paragraph is now

MTGO is watched too: each game appears once it ends.

, and SourcesSection.tsx's set-folder hint is 'Each game is read once it ends.'. grep confirms no mtgo_read_at_startup under src/ or web/src/. All five check commands exit 0 (pytest 212 passed, ruff clean, gen:types, tsc -b, lint).
concerns: docs/status.md still mentions the old behavior/name, but docs were declared out of scope
The docstring now says only watching and mtgo_watching come from the watcher object; confirm that phrasing matches the intended contract
